topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: I really wish we had the chance to talk sooner about your assignment. I know you put a lot of effort into your work, and I can see how passionate you are about the subject. It’s important to me that you understand the standards and tools we have in academic writing, especially when it comes to citing sources. I think, had we gone over this earlier, we might have avoided this misunderstanding. I hope we can sit down and go through the assignment together, so I can help you see where the issues arose and how we can fix them. I’m here to support you, and I believe you can do great things with just a bit more guidance.
